title: image-panel config
description: The shape of an image-panel JSON file and of the `config` property: a settings object, or just an array of slides. Annotations starting `x-` are for authoring tools: `x-attribute` is a setting's HTML attribute, `x-inherits` names the panel setting a slide field overrides, and `x-attributeOnly` lists options that only exist as attributes.

keyboard.description: Arrow keys, Home and End navigate. Makes the panel focusable.

swipe.description: Dragging sideways with touch, pen or mouse navigates. Vertical drags still scroll the page.

pause-on-hover.description: Hold auto-advance while the pointer is over the panel.

config.description: Every setting is optional, and attributes take priority over config values.

$schema.description: Ignored by the panel. Lets editors find this schema.

basePath.description: Prefix for slide URLs. Relative paths resolve against the JSON file's URL, or the page for inline config.

interval.description: Milliseconds each slide is shown for, after its transition finishes.

transition.description: Default transition for slides without their own.

transitionEasing.description: Easing for wipe, slide and push transitions: any CSS easing function.

transitionDuration.description: Transition length in ms. 0 for a hard cut. Always 0 when the user prefers reduced motion.

loop.description: Wrap round from the last slide to the first, and back.

focalRange.description: Default focal range: how far random motion may take the focal point from the centre.

sizes.description: Default `sizes` for slides with a srcset. Defaults to the panel's rendered width.

fillPanel.description: Never show the panel background behind a slide.

metadata.description: Fill in missing slide fields from each image's XMP, IPTC and EXIF metadata.

motion.description: Default motion for slides without their own. Only string values can be set as an attribute.

slide.description: A plain image URL, or an object. Fields not listed here are kept and passed back in events, for your own captions and credits.

alt.description: Alt text. Falls back to title. Use "" for purely decorative images.

title.description: Not displayed. Passed back in events.

description.description: Not displayed. Passed back in events.

creator.description: Not displayed. Passed back in events.

copyright.description: Not displayed. Passed back in events.

focalPoint.description: The part of the image that matters. "none" turns off a panel-wide default.

transform.description: Any CSS transform. Applied before flip.

motion.description: false or "none" turns off a panel-wide default.

style.description: Raw inline CSS for the . The fields above take priority.

focalPoint.description: A point in the image, written like background-position with keywords and percentages (no lengths). `25% 40%` is a quarter of the way across and 40% down. Check values with parseFocalPoint from image-panel/authoring.

focalRange.description: One percentage for both axes, or horizontal then vertical, from 0% (as central as possible) to 100% (anywhere in frame).

transition.description: A transition name and its options, separated by spaces, or false for a hard cut.

dip.description: Fade out to a colour, then in from it. Without one it uses --image-panel-dip-color (black).

wipe.description: An edge sweeps across. The feather is a CSS length, or a bare number in px.

slide.description: The new slide slides in over the old one.

push.description: The new slide pushes the old one out. Cardinal directions only.

x-directions.default: follows navigation: left going forward, right going back, mirrored right to left

motion.description: A slow pan or zoom over the slide's time on screen (both transitions plus the interval).

origin.description: A CSS transform-origin. Defaults to the focal point, or the centre.
A CSS transform-origin. Defaults to the focal point, or the centre.

motionFrames.description: CSS transforms, spread evenly over the motion.

motionFrame.description: A CSS transform. Empty or null means none.
